name: kanban-board-app
description: Mini Kanban Board with user authentication and real-time updates

scripts.dev: node api.js && concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: node api.js && cd backend && npm run dev
scripts.dev:frontend: node api.js && cd frontend && npm run dev
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
